hostname asa-nat-conformance
object network REAL_HOST
 host 10.0.0.10
object network REAL_SUBNET
 subnet 10.0.1.0 255.255.255.0
object network REAL_RANGE
 range 10.0.2.10 10.0.2.20
object network PUBLIC_HOST
 host 203.0.113.10
object network PRIVATE_SERVER
 host 10.0.0.20
object network PAT_POOL
 range 203.0.113.20 203.0.113.30
object-group network NESTED
 network-object host 10.0.3.10
object-group network MIXED
 network-object host 10.0.3.11
 network-object 10.0.4.0 255.255.255.0
 group-object NESTED
nat (inside,outside) source static REAL_HOST PUBLIC_HOST
nat (inside,outside) source dynamic REAL_SUBNET interface
nat (inside,outside) source dynamic REAL_RANGE pat-pool PAT_POOL
nat (outside,inside) source static any interface destination static PUBLIC_HOST PRIVATE_SERVER service tcp 80 8080
nat (inside,outside) source static REAL_HOST PUBLIC_HOST destination static PUBLIC_HOST PRIVATE_SERVER
nat (inside,outside) source static REAL_HOST REAL_HOST
nat (inside,outside) after-auto 99 source dynamic REAL_HOST interface
